sources.title: Politeness - The Comprehensive R Archive Network
sources.snippet: However, the causes and consequences of politeness are often situationally specific. Furthermore, the particular set of linguistic markers that define politeness can also vary from context to context. Thus, it would be difficult (or misleading) to estimate a single model as some universal "politeness classifier" for all situations.
